sources.title: How a rural school built an AI model to predict crop diseases
sources.snippet: The AI tool has already helped dozens of farmers reduce crop loss, increasing yields by up to 30%. Encouraged by these results, the students are now working on expanding their model to detect multiple crop diseases and translate diagnoses into local dialects for better comprehension.
